# ReDY source archive

`ReDY.tgz` is the original ReDY v0.3 archive by Marco Bonvini, copied unchanged.
Its fixed-order coefficients originate from Vrap by Lance Dixon. The archive
contains the upstream README and installation instructions.

PIXEL uses the fixed-order NNLO functions through its `ReDYNNLOSource` adapter.
The closure suites default to this repository copy; set
`PIXEL_CLOSURE_DY_NNLO_SOURCE` to use another archive or extracted source tree.

SHA-256: `856dfa70fb622d04f7c13d5c35a57935ae154ef74a0f697199711edb462f6ce8`.
